source.invalidation_reason: The same three YAML cases and numerical outcomes are already retained in research/byrnes_zenodo_exploratory_result.json and research/byrnes_typei_thermal_prospective_result_2026_10_08.json; this archive is not an independent untouched holdout.

scope.claim: An independent public hydrogen pressure-vessel blowdown trace can be replayed with the frozen real-gas vessel model without case-specific parameter fitting.

model.parameters: source YAML geometry, wall properties, ambient boundary and discharge coefficient only

screens.joint_pass_rule: all declared hydrogen discharge cases pass both screens

claim_boundary: This protocol covers only public hydrogen vessel blowdown component behavior. It does not validate a station-to-vehicle loop, filling control, ignition, dispersion, radiation, ESD effectiveness or emergency separation distance.
